senses.gloss:
लिप् लिप्, i. 6, लिम्प, Par. Ātm.
 1. To anoint, Bhaṭṭ. 14, 94.
 2. To smear, Hit. 21, 14.
 3. To stain (लिप्यते दोषेण, Incurs sin), Hit. ii. d. 118; to pollute, Man. 4, 201; 10, 104.
 4. To burn, Bhaṭṭ. 6, 22.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लिप्त.
 1. Envenomed.
 2. Embraced.
 3. Defiled.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. To cause to be decorated, Rām. 2, 9, 40.
 --With the [] prep. अनु अनु,
 1. To anoint, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 6.
 2. To smear, Śiś. 9, 15. अनुलिप्त,
 1. Smeared, Pañc. iii. d. 32.
 2. Anointed, Hit. 90, 8, M.M.; glistening, Śāk. d. 166.
 --Caus. To cause to be anointed, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 7.
 --With अव अव, To smear, Lass. 9, 19. अवलिप्त, Proud, arrogant, Man. 4, 79; Pañc. i. d. 341.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To anoint, Utt. Rāmac. 79, 1; Ṛt. 6, 12, v. r.
 2. To smear, Pañc. 171, 11.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To anoint, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 5.
 --With उप उप, To pollute, MBh. 2, 2625; Bhag. 13, 32.
 --Caus. To let smear, Man. 3, 206.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To anoint, Bhaṭṭ. 3, 20.
 2. To smear, Lass. 9, 12.
 3. To pollute, Hit. 128, 12.
 --With सम् सम्, To anoint, MBh. 1, 4950.
 --Cf. λίπος, λιπαρής, ἀ-λείϕω, λισσός; Lat. limpidus, lippus; probably also liquidus, liquere, and O.H.G. salba; Goth. salbôn; A.S. sealf.

लिपि and लिपी लिप् + ई̆, f.
 1. Anointing, smearing.
 2. Painting.
 3. Writing, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 7; the alphabet, Ragh. 18, 45.
 4. A written paper or book.

लिपिकर and लिपिकार लिपि-कार, m.
 1. A scribe.
 2. -कर, A plasterer, whitener, Rām. 1, 12, 6 Gorr.

लिप्तक लिप्त + क (vb. लिप्), m.
 A poisoned arrow.
लिप्सा लिप्सा, i. e. लिप्स, desider. of लभ्, + अ, f. Wish.
लिप्सु लिप्सु, i. e. लिप्स (see the last), + उ, adj. Desirous, greedy, Pañc. 5, 4.
